title: Boundary Line Maintenance Nimrod-Blue Mountain Lakes
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > SWD > W076 ENDIST LITTLE ROCK
description:
This is a Combined Synopsis/Solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with part 12.  This announcement constitutes the only solicitation.  Quotes are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. 

 This is a non-personal services contract to provide boundary line maintenance services to the Nimrod-Blue Mountain Project Lakes Project Office.  The Contractor shall furnish all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision and other items and non-personal services necessary to perform boundary line maintenance as defined in the Performance Work Statement except for those items specified as government furnished property and services.  The Contractor shall perform to the standards in this contract.
